failure_reason: Category tree successfully built via tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi, chrome124 impersonation) reading the server-rendered mobile mega-menu embedded in the homepage HTML (data-el=navigation-mobile-panel-menu, 'Produits' panel, 350 nested category nodes). However, every individual category/listing page (/FR/fr/c/...) and the XML sitemap returned DataDome 403 (geo.captcha-delivery.com challenge) under tier (a) across 5 browser-impersonation profiles (chrome124/131/120/99, safari17_0, edge101), and under tier (b) Playwright in three configurations: headless bundled Chromium, headless real installed Chrome (channel=chrome), and headed real Chrome with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was confirmed disconnected (list_connected_browsers empty) per task instructions, so it could not be tried. As a result, all sub_category names/links/hierarchy were captured with confidence, but qty could not be retrieved for any leaf row and is null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag on each, per the no-estimate rule.
notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP via curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome124) succeeded for the homepage https://www.maisonsdumonde.com/FR/fr (200, full SSR HTML including a complete mobile mega-menu 'Produits' panel with 350 nested category/subcategory nodes) but was blocked (403 DataDome) for every /FR/fr/c/... category page and for /FR/fr/sitemap_index.xml, tried under 5 browser-impersonation profiles. Escalated to tier (b) Playwright: headless bundled Chromium (403), headless real Chrome via channel=chrome (403), headed real Chrome with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled (403) - all blocked identically before any page content rendered. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome confirmed disconnected per task brief, not attempted (no CAPTCHA-bypass attempted, per hard prohibition). robots.txt (readable via tier a) lists Anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot etc. only under path-specific Disallow rules (account/search/cart/etc, not full-site), so tier (c) would have been permitted if connected. TREE: built from the homepage's server-rendered mobile navigation panel labeled 'Produits' (data-el=navigation-mobile-panel-menu__multi-level, recursively parsed via lxml through nested data-el=navigation-menu-multi-level-children divs), which is the site's full product-type category tree (12 top-level departments, 350 nodes total) - this satisfies the mega-menu leg of the required union; the XML sitemap leg could not be read (blocked) and the room-based 'Pieces' menu was not separately walked because it links the same category URLs already covered by 'Produits', so revisiting it would only relink identical URLs under a different (room) grouping, which the ruleset explicitly says must not itself change classification. QTY: none obtainable - every category listing page is DataDome-blocked at all reachable tiers; all leaf rows carry qty=null and a MANUAL REVIEW flag describing exactly what was tried, per the no-estimate/no-fabrication rule. CLASSIFICATION: Textile rows come from four site branches - 'Linge de maison' (Home Linen: decorative linen, bed linen, table linen, bath linen), 'Literie' (Bedding: only the textile children Couettes/Oreillers/Aleses et protege-matelas/Surmatelas were kept - Lits/Tetes de lit/Matelas/Sommiers/Tables de chevet/Bouts de lit in that same department are Furniture and were dropped), 'Meubles et Deco enfant' (only 'Linge bebe et enfant' and the textile leaves of 'Decoration enfant' were kept - Meubles enfant, Eveil et jeux, Equipement de puericulture, and the non-textile leaves of Decoration enfant are Furniture/toys/baby-gear and were dropped, e.g. 'Matelas de sol enfant', 'Langes et bavoirs', 'Gigoteuses', 'Sacs et matelas a langer', 'Coussins d'allaitement' were excluded as baby apparel/equipment not home textile), and 'Jardin' (only 'Coussins de jardin' and 'Housses de protection' - outdoor cushions and furniture covers - qualify; the rest of the Jardin tree is garden furniture/decor). Storage rows come from 'Deco > Rangements decoratifs' (Vide-poches excluded as decorative-only per storage.md S23/24), 'Jardin > Amenagement de jardin > Rangements exterieur', 'Meubles et Deco enfant > Decoration enfant > Boites et paniers de rangements enfant', 'Cuisine & Electromenager > Conservation et rangements de cuisine' (only the two genuine storage children kept; Bocaux/pots/bonbonnieres, Gourdes et mugs de voyage, Lunch box et sacs isothermes, and Poubelles were excluded as Kitchen & Dining / non-storage per storage.md S26), and 'Animaux de compagnie > Boites a croquettes' (pet food storage container, explicit example in storage.md S31 - other pet nodes Gamelles/Paniers-jouets-tapis pour animaux/Arbre a chat excluded as pet bowls/pet beds/pet furniture). EXCLUDED across the board: all Furniture (Meubles, Meubles de rangement, wardrobes, bookcases, shelving under Meubles/*, Meubles a chaussures under Meubles d'entrees), Lighting (Luminaires), Kitchen & Dining tableware/cookware/small appliances, Wall Decor and decorative objects (candles, vases, mirrors, frames), 'Serviettes en papier' (paper napkins, not fabric), 'Vide-poches' and 'Corbeilles a pain et fruits'/'Plateaux' (decorative-only, not storage), and 'Housses de protection' de-duplicated to a single row (same href appears once in the menu). No View-All/search/collection/product-detail URLs were used; every link is a canonical /FR/fr/c/... category-listing URL taken verbatim from the mega-menu HTML with no query-string filters appended.
